assertions.description: The rev1 flat schematic (no hierarchy, no MCU on-sheet, uses Pro Micro connectors J5/J6) correctly detects the 5x7 key matrix with ROW_0..ROW_4 and COL_0..COL_6, counting exactly 35 switch and 35 diode components all on the matrix. The 4 PWR_FLAG warnings (VCC, GND, VBUS, +BATT have no PWR_FLAG or power_out driver) are accurate—rev1 uses Pro Micro connectors without explicit power flags. The 17 label_shape_warnings for ROW/COL global labels shaped as 'input' with no driver are correctly flagged since the MCU is external.
assertions.migration_note: Path migrated from: signal_analysis.key_matrices[0].estimated_keys; TH-109 triage: {"path": "findings[0].estimated_keys", "op": "equals", "value": 35, "detector_filter": "detect_key_matrices"} -> {"path": "findings", "op": "contains_match", "field": "estimated_keys", "pattern": "^35$", "where": {"rows": "^5$", "columns": "^7$", "switches_on_matrix": "^35$", "diodes_on_matrix": "^35$"}, "detector_filter": "detect_key_matrices"} (5x7 matrix with 35 switches and diodes (description says correct). Passes (graduation candidate). File moved by 745481c0044.)

assertions.description: INCORRECT: The bus_topology 'width' field reports the total number of label placements on the sheet rather than the number of unique signal names. In the rev1 schematic, COL_0..COL_6 (7 unique nets) produces width=18 because each global label appears 2-3 times in the schematic. Similarly, ROW_0..ROW_4 (5 unique nets) gives width=20. This is a bug in analyze_bus_topology() at line 4109: `'width': len(members)` where 'members' is the un-deduplicated list of label occurrences. The fix is `len(set(members))` or deduplication before counting.
